content_sections.heading: DGHS Consultant (ASO) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.directorate_general_of_health_services_m: Last pay drawn minus pension plus TA at the rate drawn at retirement
Directorate General of Health Services (HQ), New Delhi, Subordinate offices of DGHS located in New Delhi

Retired Central Government officers/officials from substantive Pay Level 10, 9, 8 & 7 of the CSS Cadre, including those retired/superannuated up to October 2026; retired/discharged Defence Forces / CAPF personnel (Pay Level 7 to 10) up to October 2026 may also apply. Profound knowledge of administrative, establishment and financial matters, Service Rules, noting, drafting, MS Office, typing and e-office.
Below 62 years (as on the date of advertisement)

Section Officer, Administration-I Section, Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Room No. 508, PG Hostel, NCDC Building, 22, Sham Nath Marg, Civil Lines, Delhi - 110054

content_sections.heading: DGHS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. A.15019/03/2020-प्रशासन-1 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DGHS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Profound knowledge of administrative, establishment and financial matters such as recruitment rules, court cases, promotion, reservation and GeM procurement Excellent knowledge of Service Rules, Regulations, Policies, Noting and Drafting Knowledge of Computer (MS Office), typing and e-office Must possess good health and be in a position to join immediately Applicant declares being clear from vigilance angle at the time of retirement

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration fixed by the formula last pay drawn minus pension plus TA at the rate drawn at retirement; it stays unchanged for the entire term. Purely on contract basis, temporary but likely to continue till regular incumbent joins the post Initially for one year from joining, may be extended/curtailed as per requirement or performance No extension beyond the age of 65 years except in extreme organizational exigencies Either side may terminate with at least 15 days prior notice; immediate termination for unfitness, insubordination or misconduct 1.5 days' absence per completed calendar month with remuneration; not more than three days in a single spell Working hours 9.30 a.m. to 6.00 p.m., Monday to Friday, with Aadhar Enabled Biometric Attendance

content_sections.heading: How Will DGHS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Engagement of retired government officers on contract basis

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of PPO (Pension Payment Order) Self-attested copy of LPC (Last Pay Certificate) Recent passport size photograph affixed on the form Relevant documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DGHS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill particulars in the application format enclosed with the circular. Attach relevant documents, including self-attested copies of PPO and LPC, and affix a recent passport size photograph. Submit to the Section Officer, Administration-I Section, Directorate General of Health Services, Room No. 508, PG Hostel, NCDC Building, 22, Sham Nath Marg, Civil Lines, Delhi - 110054. Submit on or before 30 November, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Number of consultants (5) may vary No facility other than remuneration will be provided No typing assistance shall be provided May be called on holidays or beyond working hours without compensatory leave Consultant must not engage in private business conflicting with Government interest and must keep official information confidential

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DGHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DGHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Consultant (ASO).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DGHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format enclosed with the circular (pages 4-5 of the PDF)) and send it to Section Officer, Administration-I Section, Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Room No. 508, PG Hostel, NCDC Building, 22, Sham Nath Marg, Civil Lines, Delhi - 110054, by by post or in person, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 62 years (as on the date of advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Last pay drawn minus pension plus TA at the rate drawn at retirement.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Central Government officers/officials from substantive Pay Level 10, 9, 8 & 7 of the CSS Cadre, including those retired/superannuated up to October 2026; retired/discharged Defence Forces / CAPF personnel (Pay Level 7 to 10) up to October 2026 may also apply. Profound knowledge of administrative, establishment and financial matters, Service Rules, noting, drafting, MS Office, typing and e-office.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Profound knowledge of administrative, establishment and financial matters such as recruitment rules, court cases, promotion, reservation and GeM procurement. Excellent knowledge of Service Rules, Regulations, Policies, Noting and Drafting. Knowledge of Computer (MS Office), typing and e-office. Must possess good health and be in a position to join immediately.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement of retired government officers on contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis, temporary but likely to continue till regular incumbent joins the post. Initially for one year from joining, may be extended/curtailed as per requirement or performance. No extension beyond the age of 65 years except in extreme organizational exigencies.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by DGHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Directorate General of Health Services (HQ), New Delhi, Subordinate offices of DGHS located in New Delhi.
